## Technical Architecture Directives
- **Zero Heavy Framework Lock-In:** Core portfolio uses Vanilla HTML5, Vanilla CSS3 (Active Theory/Dona Nova design system), and Vanilla ES6+ WebGL/Canvas.
- **Privacy-First:** User telemetry and personal data are kept client-side; zero unauthorized tracking.
- **Open Source Security:** Public code repositories are screened against hardcoded tokens, secret leakage, and supply-chain vulnerabilities.
